brief_rationale: The doctor completed 21 turns, used workspace records, and guided the family through preoperative medication reconciliation, intraoperative observation, and discharge planning. All seven responsibility chain items were met without serious error; however, RC7 (teachback) was only partial because the final confirmation focused on recalling symptoms/actions but did not explicitly check whether the family could recite the full medication/allergy list and the distinction between perioperative antibiotics and home drugs. No safety-critical error occurred, so the maximum grade is at least 3. Among the four high-order points, HO3 (dynamic reprioritization) and HO4 (safe bounded closure) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying Strong and reaching Perfect criteria. The closure is safe, executable, and traceable as valid_open/valid_closure. This trajectory meets all requirements for Grade 5.
